sabbath_exception.reason: Clayton explicitly requested an exception after family travel and before a Saturday full-day church obligation. This authorization is exact-date and nonprecedential.

decision_basis.physical_readiness: Readiness 78/green; sleep 6.78 h with score 83; wake/current Body Battery 71/72; overnight HRV 47 ms balanced; resting HR 48 equal to the seven-day average.
decision_basis.cns_readiness: CNS 75.6/ready. Body Battery does not independently promote consequence or intensity.
decision_basis.recent_load: The 2026-07-25 MTB session was 91.2 min, Garmin load 163.6, aerobic TE 3.5, anaerobic TE 2.4, and athlete RPE 7; therefore this exception cannot contain tempo, torque, sprints, or threshold work.
decision_basis.garmin_diagnosis: ACWR 0.5 LOW. Low-aerobic load 261.86 is approximately 1 point below the 263 minimum, high-aerobic load 951.8 is above the 872 maximum, and anaerobic load 307.8 is within target. Add low-aerobic continuity only.
decision_basis.power_anchor: Garmin cycling FTP endpoint and latest outdoor activity surface 211 W effective 2026-07-25. A 125 W steady segment is 59.2% FTP. Suito power is accepted for work below approximately 200 W.

session.title: One-off Suito low-aerobic bridge
session.purpose: Restore bike-specific low-aerobic continuity after travel without compromising Monday's social run or Tuesday's protected Kiara quality.

dose.main_set: 40-45 min at 120-125 W. Treat 125 W as a ceiling, not an obligation.
dose.total_cap: 55-60 min. If the legs are more than mildly heavy, finish at 45-50 min.
dose.intensity_anchor: RPE 2-3, conversational, naturally comfortable cadence, seated throughout.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A continuous dose near 59% of current Garmin FTP should add low-cost mitochondrial and capillary stimulus plus bike-frequency continuity, improving between-stage aerobic recovery while preserving normal legs and cognition for the next two days.
execution_rules: Remain seated and conversational; use a natural cadence rather than low-cadence torque.
No sprints, standing surges, tempo blocks, intervals, or extension beyond 60 minutes.
Establish a steady-power HR reference during minutes 15-25; interpret later HR together with heat, cadence, and RPE rather than chasing a single number.
Normal food is sufficient if already fed; use water to thirst. Carbohydrate during the session is optional, not required for this easy one-hour dose.
The objective is low-aerobic time, not repairing ACWR or Garmin Load Focus in one session.

expected_result.power: Steady segment at 120-125 W; 125 W equals 59.2% of current Garmin FTP.
expected_result.heart_rate: Likely approximately 120-130 bpm from Clayton's comparable steady trainer sessions, but individual response governs.
expected_result.training_effect: Aerobic TE approximately 2.3-2.7, anaerobic TE 0, and zero intentional high-intensity minutes.
expected_result.next_day: Monday's conversational run feels normal; Tuesday legs, clarity, and technical appetite remain available.

stop_rules: Do not progress to 120-125 W after the warm-up if RPE exceeds 3, weak/heavy legs worsen, or HR/breathing is abnormal for this power.
Reduce power by 5-10 W if fixed-power HR rises approximately 8 bpm above the established reference, RPE reaches 4, or cadence/form deteriorates.
Finish at 30-45 min if HR/RPE does not settle after the reduction or the session is no longer restorative.
Stop immediately for dizziness, chest symptoms, illness symptoms, pain, or disproportionate breathlessness.
No same-day upgrade is permitted even if the legs feel excellent.
